Ten comments

The Mill Stream

I transcribed this tune (as best as I can) from a YouTube video of The Gloaming. It’s from the Opening Set, Set 8 in the recording. According to Tunepal there is a very similar tune in Bill Black’s Miscellaneous Collection called Jessie’s, played from Peter and Angelina Carberry on there CD Memories from the Holla. I think the tune that The Gloaming are playing is a version of Jessie’s (or vice versa), but I’m not sure.

↳ Posted by DetlefS on April 6th, 2014.

The Mill Stream

It is the same tune as on Memories from the Holla. There’s a tune in the Petrie Collection called The Mill Stream, which is in G. It’s got some striking similarities, but I’m not at all sure it’s the same tune. It can be found here: http://tunearch.org/wiki/Mill_Stream_%28The%29

↳ Posted by GaryAMartin on April 7th, 2014.

Mill Stream Petrie Collection

After transposing this setting to D and comparing it I would think this is the tune. And after hearing the recording again (and again and..) I changed a few notes in A-Part Bar 2 and B-Part Bar 3 to the setting from Petrie. Funnily enough this was what I transcribed first yesterday evening but after hearing the tune over and over I got it wrong.

↳ Posted by DetlefS on April 7th, 2014.

Jessie’s

The Second setting is from the playing of Peter and Angelina Carberry on their CD ‘Memories from the Holla’ (https://thesession.org/recordings/1125).
They call this tune Jessie’s (Clare Reel).

↳ Posted by DetlefS on April 13th, 2014.

Do Beoga also play this? I can definitely recall a warped version of this from a Beoga track.

↳ Posted by fluther on January 24th, 2015.
